_note: A land or building acquired before 1-4-2001 is computed on its price, while 2025 s.90(9)(a)–(b), (10) / 1961 s.55(2)(b)(i) and its proviso let the taxpayer take its fair market value on that date instead, no more than its stamp-duty value then — which can only lower the tax. Not built (W-088g8): neither value is held. The date is the law's, so it is this row's condition. An ATTENTION notice on the bucket's term line (W-088g4, D-432); building W-088g8 deletes the row. Sources: docs/taxplanning-build/sources/2026-11-01-land-sale-provisions.md rows 4, 5, 10, 11.
